Hypergraph node centralities, as a tidy table

Source: R/text_verbs.R
hg_centrality.Rd

Delegates to hypergraph_centrality(): clique-expansion eigenvector centrality and the tensor Z- and H-eigenvector centralities.

Usage

hg_centrality(
  hg,
  type = c("clique", "Z", "H"),
  sort_by = NULL,
  n = Inf,
  max_iter = 1000L,
  tol = 1e-08,
  normalize = TRUE
)

Arguments

hg

A text_hypergraph() (or any honets net_hypergraph).

type

Centralities to compute; any of "clique", "Z", "H" (default: all three).

sort_by

Optional centrality name to sort by, descending (ties broken by node name); default keeps node order.

n

Return only the first n rows after sorting (default all) – e.g. sort_by = "clique", n = 10 for the ten most central nodes.

max_iter, tol, normalize

Passed to hypergraph_centrality().

Value

A base data.frame, one row per node (or the n requested rows), with one column per requested centrality.

Examples

hg <- text_hypergraph(c(
  a = "salt and soup and onions",
  b = "soup and salt",
  c = "stars and salt"
))
hg_centrality(hg, type = "clique")
#>   node    clique
#> 1    a 0.6059128
#> 2    b 0.6059128
#> 3    c 0.5154991
